instruction: Add the rentalcars.com page to your Chrome bookmarks bar.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_bookmarks) correctly reads Chrome's Bookmarks JSON file and returns the 'roots' dict, which contains the 'bookmark_bar' key used by the metric.

Metric (is_expected_bookmarks) with type 'bookmark_bar_websites_urls' correctly checks bookmarks['bookmark_bar']['children'] for URL entries — this is the right state for verifying a bookmark bar addition.

expected.type='rule' is handled correctly: the framework passes the rules dict directly to the metric as the 'rule' parameter, and the metric accesses rule['type'] and rule['urls'] directly — no incorrect wrapper nesting.
Negative-control resistance is satisfied: the initial state has no rentalcars.com bookmark, so the evaluator correctly returns 0 without agent action.

Minor concern: the expected URL is 'https://www.rentalcars.com' (no trailing slash), but the setup config opens 'https://www.rentalcars.com/' (with trailing slash). Chrome typically stores the bookmarked URL exactly as it was navigated, so the stored value may be 'https://www.rentalcars.com/' causing a false negative on exact string set comparison.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Normalize the expected URL to include a trailing slash: change 'https://www.rentalcars.com' to 'https://www.rentalcars.com/' in the rules.urls array, or use the compare_urls utility (which the metric currently does not use for URL comparison in this branch) to handle trailing-slash variants.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened rentalcars.com but was blocked by a persistent CAPTCHA. Spent 50 turns attempting CAPTCHA challenges (beds, buckets, curtains) with repeated time-limit failures. Eventually bypassed CAPTCHA around step 40+ and reached the main rentalcars.com page, but exhausted step budget before completing the car search.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can click UI elements, interact with CAPTCHA grids, navigate Chrome address bar, and eventually reach the rentalcars.com main page.
metadata.failure_analysis: The rentalcars.com CAPTCHA consumed the entire step budget. The agent never reached the car search results page and could not sort by price or filter by car size.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to bookmarking the currently open rentalcars.com page. Achievable from either the CAPTCHA page or the main page using Ctrl+D without requiring a search result.
metadata.explanation: Task requires pressing Ctrl+D (or using the star icon) to bookmark the rentalcars.com page and saving it to the bookmarks bar. Evaluator checks that rentalcars.com URL appears in the Chrome bookmarks bar. The initial state has no rentalcars.com bookmark, so the evaluator will fail at start.
